newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Agresearch posts NZ$1.54 mln half yr net profit.
newsitem.headline: Agresearch posts NZ$1.54 mln half yr net profit.

text.p: New Zealand Pastoral Agriculture Research Institute (Agresearch) made a NZ$1.54 million net profit for the half year to December 31, 1996 and believes it is on track to achieve a full-year net profit of $3.38 million, the New Zealand Press Association reported on Monday.

Agresearch said in its half-yearly report, tabled in Parliament, that the figure showed an improved performance against its operating budget of $1.25 million, caused by a greater level of general cost savings than budgeted for.
